title: Build a reliable Bedrock request
description: Configure a controlled Bedrock SDK substitute for bounded retries, structured output, output safety, and privacy-safe telemetry.

starterFiles.content: export const requestPolicy = { retries: 0, schema: false, blockUnsafe: false, telemetry: 'raw' };

checkpoints.title: Harden the request path
checkpoints.objective: Configure bounded retries, strict structured output, unsafe-output blocking, and sanitized telemetry.
checkpoints.instructions: Use the controlled operations to update the remote workspace, then ask the server to validate observable state.
hints: Enable strict schema and unsafe-output blocking.
Raw model output must not enter telemetry.

debrief.explanation: Reliable model calls need bounded retries, validated output, explicit safety handling, and telemetry minimization.
debrief.prevention: Keep these controls in shared request infrastructure and verify them with deterministic integration checks.
